episodes.title: The first report
outcomes: Separate observation from inference with explicit uncertainty
episodes.activity: Sort eyewitness observation and inference and justify one distinction
episodes.assessment: Fresh short account with observation/inference and uncertainty
optionalExperiments: Choose evidence inspection order; revisit a source after testing a claim
episodes.recovery: Source gloss, worked evidence comparison, exemplar and assisted exit; self-reports remain unverified

episodes.title: Who should we trust?
outcomes: Evaluate provenance, purpose and limits of a historical source
episodes.activity: Compare source author, purpose, date and access; select a useful claim and limitation
episodes.assessment: Fresh provenance comparison with an authored rubric
optionalExperiments: Choose evidence inspection order; revisit a source after testing a claim
episodes.recovery: Source gloss, worked evidence comparison, exemplar and assisted exit; self-reports remain unverified

episodes.title: Follow the evidence
outcomes: Corroborate independent accounts using maps and chronology
episodes.activity: Reconstruct a schematic map/timeline from corroborating accounts; test competing spread explanations
episodes.assessment: Compare a new pair of accounts for independent corroboration
optionalExperiments: Choose evidence inspection order; revisit a source after testing a claim
episodes.recovery: Source gloss, worked evidence comparison, exemplar and assisted exit; self-reports remain unverified

episodes.title: Make the case
outcomes: Build a defensible multi-causal explanation and acknowledge alternatives
episodes.activity: Construct a causal account from inspected evidence and acknowledge an alternative
episodes.assessment: Fresh claim using two sources, mechanism and uncertainty; human rubric review
optionalExperiments: Choose evidence inspection order; revisit a source after testing a claim
episodes.recovery: Source gloss, worked evidence comparison, exemplar and assisted exit; self-reports remain unverified

traceability.outcome: Separate observation from inference with explicit uncertainty
traceability.independentEvidence: Human-reviewed fresh source task against authored rubric; structural checks alone do not imply mastery
traceability.transfer: Another source/date or unfamiliar historical claim supplied with sufficient context
traceability.criterion: Relevant evidence, correct source distinction and explicit limit; no one-answer collapse of defensible interpretations

researchDecisions.decision: Distinguish observed events, inferred mechanisms and uncertain origin
researchDecisions.strength: Museum historical synthesis and myth discussion accessed
researchDecisions.limitations: Museum interpretation is secondary historical evidence; it is an authoritative factual reference, not an eyewitness; illustrations copyrighted
researchDecisions.validation: Use own labelled schematic/map; compare actual primary accounts; no invented quotations

researchDecisions.decision: Investigate provenance, context and corroboration before forming a claim
researchDecisions.strength: Provider curriculum guidance and linked evaluation overview inspected
researchDecisions.limitations: Practice guidance/evaluation summary; original evaluation paper not yet read; classroom support differs from solo learners
researchDecisions.validation: Authored evidence rubric and human evaluation of defensible interpretations

researchDecisions.decision: Provide tap/click and keyboard alternatives to dragging
researchDecisions.limitations: Standards compliance is not established by screenshots; actual reader/device experience may differ
researchDecisions.validation: Drive real interactions, focus, text alternatives, reduced motion and text expansion

researchDecisions.decision: Offer hints, representation, worked example, prerequisite, retry and escape
researchDecisions.strength: Owner contract plus guided-inquiry/feedback evidence motivates support
researchDecisions.limitations: Exact ladder and idle cutoff are hypotheses; inactivity alone does not show difficulty
researchDecisions.validation: Record help; assisted paths never give independent credit; owner revision
